Health Functional FoodManganese 3mgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin K 70μgOnce a day

비타민K2&D3Manganese · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin K

Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 3mg of Manganese, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 10μg of Vitamin D, 70μg of Vitamin K as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 3mg Manganese, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 70μg Vitamin K
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (3mg / 450mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 450mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 450mg), 80~180%
Vitamin K labelled (70μg / 450mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미 이취가 없는 하양색의 장방형 제피 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하여 실온에 보관하시고, 영·유아 및 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Vitamin K together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
